name: trzsz-go
description: Simple file transfer tools, similar to lrzsz (rz/sz), and compatible with tmux

repo.name: trzsz-go
repo.description: trzsz-go is the go version of trzsz, makes all terminals that support local shell to support trzsz ( trz / tsz ).

readme.summary: Excellent installation coverage across all platforms with clear usage examples, though the core concept of what trzsz actually does could be more prominent upfront.
readme.top_issue: The opening explanation assumes familiarity with rz/sz and doesn't clearly explain what file transfer problem trzsz solves for users unfamiliar with these tools.

injection_risks.description: The `sendString` function is used to send user-controlled data over the network, but it does not appear to perform any validation or sanitization on this data. This could potentially lead to injection attacks if an attacker can manipulate the data being sent.

The `recvString` function is used to receive user-controlled data from the network, but it does not appear to perform any validation or sanitization on this data. This could potentially lead to injection attacks if an attacker can manipulate the data being received.

critical_findings: Potential injection risks in `sendString` and `recvString` functions
security.summary: The code has some potential security issues, including lack of input validation and potential injection risks, but it does not appear to have any critical vulnerabilities.
